intro.title: A quieter interface with stronger boundaries
intro.description: Incept collects ongoing work on products, documentation, and creative systems. It brings together public notes, focused articles, and references that can stay useful over time.

clarity.label: Clarity
clarity.value: Stable structure helps readers understand the topic, the boundary, and the next useful path.

rhythm.label: Rhythm
rhythm.value: Restrained typography and clear hierarchy make long-form content easier to scan and revisit.

mockFirst.label: Accumulation
mockFirst.value: Scattered ideas are shaped into searchable, referenceable, and reusable content assets.

shellBoundaries.title: Starting from clear page structure
shellBoundaries.summary: How stable page types and navigation relationships help content stay understandable as it grows.

navigationReview.title: Treating navigation as a content entry point
navigationReview.summary: Navigation is not only for moving around. It also explains the site's hierarchy and reading paths.

documentRhythm.title: Giving the homepage a reading rhythm
documentRhythm.summary: The homepage balances introduction, indexing, and reading so visitors can move naturally into deeper material.

mockSystem.title: Organizing a reusable content system
mockSystem.summary: Articles, references, and page modules are kept in layers so the site can expand without losing order.

closing.title: Start with the documentation
closing.description: Continue into the docs to read published articles, reference material, and future topic collections.
